reports.rendered_content: The joint mode coverage algorithm implementation is now a real, non-greedy system with deterministic area-proportional sampling and comprehensive scoring (occlusion, normals, view angle, texel density, visibility/coverage bitsets). Architecture rated 8/10; search modes 7.5/10. Two critical blockers remain: (1) imported sets using full object AABBs for clearance cause zero legal candidates when origins are inside the AABB (affects complete imported models, concave geometry, L-shaped walls); fix requires per-mesh or spatial-cluster obstacle bounds with actual geometry clearance via BVH shapecast, plus regression test. (2) Triangle-level geometry representation does not scale to heavy imports.
